empty.title: No plans yet
empty.text: Create your first plan, e.g. upper body or legs.

delete.title: Delete plan?
delete.text: The plan is removed. Past workouts stay in your history.

discard.title: Discard changes?
discard.text: Your changes to this plan will be lost.

share.title: Share plan
share.hint: The plan is shared as a template: exercises, sets, reps and rest. Your workouts stay with you.
share.notesHint: Only added to exercises the receiver has no note for yet.
share.weightStepsHint: Only used where the receiver has not picked their own.
share.codeHint: You can send the code in a chat. Paste it in Grynd under Plans → Import plan.
share.photosFileOnly: With photos the code would be too long, so share the plan as a file.
share.message:
My Grynd plan “{{name}}”. Copy the whole message and paste it in Grynd under Plans → Import plan:

{{code}}

paused.title: Workout paused
paused.text: The workout clock stands still and the rest timer is stopped. The time until you continue doesn’t count toward your workout.

resume.title: Workout in progress
resume.text: Another workout is still running. Continue it or end it first.

endDialog.title: End workout?
endDialog.text: Save the completed sets to your history or discard the workout.

exerciseNote.label: Note
exerciseNote.hint: Applies to this exercise in all plans.
exerciseNote.placeholder: e.g. seat on 4, feet high, lower slowly
exerciseNote.imagesHint: Up to {{max}} photos. They stay on your device and are just for you.
exerciseNote.imageFailed: A photo could not be added.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete photo?
deleteConfirm.text: The photo will be removed from this device.

weightStep.label: Weight step
weightStep.hint: Step for ± and the scale when setting the weight. Applies to this exercise in all plans.

empty.title: No workouts yet
empty.text: Start a workout from a plan. Finished workouts show up here.

delete.title: Delete workout?
delete.text: The workout disappears from your history and no longer counts for prefill and records.

backup.text: Save all plans, workouts and notes to a file or bring them back. Share single plans from the plan itself.

preview.title: Backup from {{date}}
preview.text: Plans: {{plans}} · Workouts: {{workouts}} · Notes: {{notes}} · Photos: {{photos}}. Merge keeps your data and adds to it, replace first deletes everything on this device.

whatsNew.title: New in Grynd {{version}}
whatsNew.text: Here’s what changed with this update.

notePhotos.title: Photos in notes
notePhotos.text: Add up to six photos to an exercise note, like your seat setting. They stay on your device and are just for you.

whatsNew.title: What’s new at a glance
whatsNew.text: After an update, Grynd briefly shows you what’s new. You can find all changes any time in the settings under “What’s new”.

pauseWorkout.title: Pause your workout
pauseWorkout.text: Need a break? Tap pause at the top: the workout clock stands still until you continue. In the meantime you can use the app as usual; your workout waits for you above the navigation.

weightStep.title: Your own weight step per exercise
weightStep.text: Dumbbells in 2 kg steps, machines in 5 kg? Choose per exercise how much + and − change the weight, from the exercise menu during a workout or in the plan.

exerciseNotes.title: Exercise notes
exerciseNotes.text: Jot down seat settings, grip or technique tips for an exercise. The note shows up right above your sets during the workout, in every plan with that exercise.

workoutPercent.title: Progress in percent
workoutPercent.text: The top of the workout screen now shows how much you’ve already done.

valueScrubber.title: Drag to change values
valueScrubber.text: Slide your finger sideways over weight or reps. A ruler shows every step, so you hit the right value quickly and precisely.

setMenu.title: Adjust sets faster
setMenu.text: Tap the set number to duplicate or delete a set. Deleted a planned set? “+ Set” brings it back.

narrowPhones.title: Fits small phones too
narrowPhones.text: Sets now fit on very narrow screens without anything being cut off.

workoutClock.title: Workout clock
workoutClock.text: The top right shows how long you’ve been training. Tap it when you want to end your workout.

historyStats.title: Statistics in your history
historyStats.text: A calendar of your training days, numbers per week, month and year, your strength progress per exercise and which muscle groups you train.

compareWorkouts.title: Compare workouts
compareWorkouts.text: Every workout shows what changed since the last time you did the same plan. You can also see all workouts of a plan at a glance.

celebrations.title: Little celebrations
celebrations.text: A check mark that pops, stars for new records and confetti when you finish an exercise or your whole workout.

firstRelease.title: Grynd is here
firstRelease.text: Build plans, check off sets with one tap (your numbers from last time are already filled in), rest timer and history. No ads, no account, everything stays on your device.

backupMerge.title: Merge backups
backupMerge.text: When importing, you first see what a backup contains. You can merge it with your data instead of replacing everything, and undo an import right after.

sharePlans.title: Share plans
sharePlans.text: Send a plan as a code in a chat or as a file, with notes, photos and weight steps if you like. Under Plans → Import plan it is added without overwriting anything.

discard.title: Discard selection?
discard.text: The selected exercises will not be added.

import.title: Import
import.hint: Choose a file or paste a code you received. Before anything changes, Grynd shows you what is inside.

errors.format: This is neither a Grynd plan nor a Grynd backup.
errors.damagedCode: The code is incomplete or damaged. Copy all of it again.
errors.newerVersion: This comes from a newer Grynd version. Update the app and try again.
errors.unknownExercise: It uses exercises this app version does not know yet. Update Grynd and try again.

plan.title: Add plan “{{name}}”?
plan.text: Exercises: {{exercises}} · Notes: {{notes}} · Weight steps: {{weightSteps}}. Your plans, workouts and notes stay as they are.
